dependency: Task 202 runner output, port 8012 thirty-six-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 203 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: SEGRO Park Kettering
features.official_source_evidence: SEGRO is the authoritative industrial-property operator and its published portfolio identifies SEGRO Park Kettering. The previously stored exact property path currently returns 404 and therefore must be replaced with a current operator path before publication.
features.classification_finding: Industrial and logistics use is supported, but the park contains multiple buildings or units and cannot be bound as one Industrial Unit. A current official path and a named unit or defensible parcel are required.

features.name: St James Quarter Edinburgh
features.official_source_evidence: The official St James Quarter site presents an Edinburgh destination to shop, dine, play and stay, and publishes St James Crescent, Edinburgh EH1 3AD.
features.classification_finding: Retail use is major and well supported, but the Quarter also contains entertainment and accommodation. A dominant-retail policy and exact centre boundary are required before retaining Retail Property.

features.name: Buchanan Galleries Glasgow
features.official_source_evidence: The official Buchanan Galleries site identifies more than 80 shops with dining and entertainment and publishes 220 Buchanan Street, Glasgow G1 2FF.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. Exact centre geometry must exclude surrounding streets and neighbouring buildings, but there is no property-type conflict.

features.name: Brent Cross Town
features.official_source_evidence: The Related Argent and Barnet Council development is documented as a large town-centre regeneration containing homes, offices, shops, schools and parkland across a broad masterplan.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is authoritative, but Brent Cross Town is a multi-building neighbourhood rather than one Mixed Building. A named building or exact parcel is required before geometry binding.

features.name: White City Place
features.official_source_evidence: The official White City Place site presents a campus with office leasing, life-sciences space, retail leasing, events and multiple occupiers and buildings at Wood Lane W12 7TP.
features.classification_finding: The campus has mixed functions, but it is not one Mixed Building. A named building or defensible campus parcel must be selected before exact geometry binding.

features.name: Kedleston Hall
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Kedleston Hall as an 18th-century mansion with vast parkland and publishes Kedleston Road, near Quarndon, Derby, Derbyshire DE22 5JH.
features.classification_finding: The principal mansion identity is authoritative, but the visitor property includes extensive parkland and heritage use. The main hall must be isolated and Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.
